source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Flash System ROM to the same version with AMI flash tool for uEFI.
1. Send command: afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME
2. Reboot the system
3. Check version in BIOS setup menu and OS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BIOS should be flashed without errors
2. Version should be shown correctly in BIOS and OS

original_test_intent: The title claims an AFULnx BIOS upgrade, while the procedure actually specifies an AFUEFI same-version reflash followed by BIOS Setup and OS version checks; the intended action/tool must be owner-resolved before execution.
original_method: Preserve both conflicting source facts, validate the exact intended tool, direction, image and region policy, establish console/stable-power/recovery controls, and only then run an approved flash with complete write and dual-location version evidence.
manual_activity: A human must resolve the conflicting action/tool, supervise the destructive console flash, and confirm the BIOS Setup version/settings. Agent staging and evidence cannot claim completion of those core decisions and observations.
required_inputs: Owner ruling on AFULnx upgrade versus AFUEFI same-version reflash
Exact board identity, approved target image/tool and hashes/signatures
Approved region flags and current BIOS/ME/security/settings baseline
Console/EFI or Linux staging method and stable AC
Recovery image/procedure and independent OOB access
safety_requirements: Do not choose a tool or direction from the contradictory source.
Do not run the shown AFUEFI command as an AFULnx upgrade without owner/vendor confirmation.
Never interrupt the flash; stop on ambiguity or first tool error and preserve output.
No automatic retry, image/flag substitution, reboot after write error or blind recovery.
Verify BIOS Setup, OS, ME, boot and security/configuration health after activation.
agent_execution_scope: Present the exact contradiction and validate owner-selected artifacts, flags, power and recovery.
Stage and capture the approved flash/reboot/OS/BMC and screenshot evidence under engineer supervision.
Prepare Tool Result without resolving the master source or issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve and document intended tool/action/target, then approve and supervise the flash.
Observe BIOS Setup version/settings and direct any recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No fit: UEFI `ver` reports shell version and omits the BIOS write and BIOS/OS version criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not recommend a replacement until the owner resolves AFULnx upgrade versus source AFUEFI same-version reflash; retain the shown command as source evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Title, same-version wording, exact AFUEFI command/flags, reboot, BIOS/OS criteria, script and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After resolving action/tool, use a signed artifact manifest, documented region policy, full write proof, controlled reboot and human-confirmed BIOS Setup plus OS health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the platform/tool/action combination explicitly approved by the owner/vendor.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record selected tool build/hash, image/hash, board revision, BIOS/ME, BMC and execution environment.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform/AMI documentation for the owner-selected AFULnx or AFUEFI workflow and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Does not silently reconcile the contradiction; adds decision provenance and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Executing the wrong direction or tool can brick the board and cannot satisfy the intended coverage.

project_override_considerations: A project may explicitly select upgrade or same-version reflash and the supported tool, but must record that as an approved override and cannot claim both source interpretations.
expected_evidence: Owner decision on tool/action, board/image/tool identities and hashes
Region policy, baseline and stable-power/recovery approval
Exact approved flash command and full write status
Reboot, OS/BMC health and engineer-confirmed BIOS Setup version/settings

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item/script say `AFULnx: upgrade`, but Procedure says same-version and commands `afuefix64.efi`, which is an AFUEFI reflash path. This is a material tool and coverage conflict and is not auto-resolved.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The record can be reviewed safely and routed for NEED_ENGINEER_DECISION; only execution is not ready until the action/tool conflict is resolved.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its unrelated shell-version-only reduction and restores flash scope.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its contradiction and safety findings while applying MANUAL ONLY for required console/BIOS Setup acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Records the engineering decision need without inventing a global policy or permanent BLOCKED status.

review_improvement: Prevents execution of an AFUEFI reflash under an AFULnx upgrade label and preserves the exact owner decision needed.
independent_technical_reasoning: Direction and tool determine firmware coverage and cannot be guessed. Regardless of the selected path, the source's console flash and BIOS Setup observation are manual core acceptance under V3.1.
